finding.summary: The frozen protected-access invocation/intent API cannot carry the RuntimeFactValue required by the already-PASSED MODEL write operation.
design_evidence: None of those frozen public inputs carries a RuntimeFactValue replacement value.
production_evidence: dec-core-model RuntimeModelAccessScope.BoundOperationPort.write consumes ResolvedProtectedWriteAccess.value() and converts it through RuntimeFactValueCodec before the real Container effect.
Without a value source, ProtectedAccessPort.invoke(ProtectedAccessInvocation) cannot represent a real WRITE while preserving Guard-before-effect and same-target/stamp semantics.
why_not_fixed_inside_dev07: Adding RuntimeFactValue to a public cross-module invocation/intent factory changes DESIGN-P2-R30 and TESTDESIGN ownership; it is not an allowed leaf implementation change under the passed DEV-07 skeleton.
Inventing a hidden default/current value would fabricate write semantics and make CASE-P2-TD-REAL-WRITE-OPERATION-001 non-representative.
Exposing an operation port/value injection seam to callers is explicitly forbidden by R05/R06.

next_legal_action: Reopen DESIGN from DESIGN-P2-R30 with an incremental revision that explicitly defines neutral WRITE-value transport while preserving ModelAccessRuleKey as the sole authority and caller isolation from MODEL ports/ModelData.
Independently review that exact Design revision.
Rebind TESTDESIGN and Implementation Plan to the approved contract.
Reopen DEV-07 skeleton only if the public/internal boundary changes, then continue concrete implementation.
